sloka: हन्यमाने बले तस्मिन्पद्मनाभेन पृष्ठतः ।माल्वान्सन्निवृत्तो ऽथ वेलामेत्य इवार्णवः ।। ७.८.१ ॥
transliteration: hanyamāne bale tasminpadmanābhena pṛṣṭhataḥ ।mālvānsannivṛtto 'tha velāmetya ivārṇavaḥ ।। 7.8.1 ॥

translations.english: When his army was being struck from behind by Padmanabha, Malvan then turned back, like the ocean reaching its shore.
